title: A-A pair at rest, separation 2.0 to 2.5, T <= 0.6: the P-0026 pair law with no sub-3 clamp predicts positions to 0.006

claims.statement: Two A particles at rest, initial separation in [2.0, 2.5], both at least 2.0 from every chamber wall, duration at most 0.6: each particle accelerates toward the other with magnitude (G/2) / r^P, where r is the current separation, G = 23.63 and P = 2.099 (the P-0026 pair law), with no separation clamp. Measured tracker positions are predicted to a judged RMSE of 0.006 of the chamber side. The claim is silent below separation 2.0 (the law reaches near-contact before t = 0.6 at separation 1.75), above 2.5, at T above 0.6, for other species, and for more than two particles.
